devices.name: Hub Pro
notes: HouseLinc names it Central Controller.
Sold as a HomeKit bridge, which current versions of HomeKit no longer support.
Its hub interface on port 25105 is expected to match the other Hubs' but hasn't been verified.

devices.name: I/O Module
notes: Has one relay, with normally open, normally closed and common contacts, and two sense inputs.
The relay's momentary mode can be set from 1 second to 30 minutes.
An I/O Module Expander, which has no INSTEON radio of its own, adds four more zones.

devices.name: Mini Remote
notes: Comes as a 4-scene remote, an 8-scene remote, and a single on/off switch.
Runs on a rechargeable battery and doesn't repeat messages.

devices.name: TempLinc Thermostat
notes: Subcategory 0x16 is the Thermostat 2.0 firmware, given its own subcategory so software can tell its features apart; HouseLinc lists it as a heat pump thermostat.
sources: TempLinc specification rev 020 and product requirements v025

devices.name: TempLinc Wireless Zone Thermostat
sources: TempLinc specification rev 020 and product requirements v025

devices.name: Micro Dimmer
notes: HouseLinc lists the regional versions as the 2442-222, 2442-422 and 2442-522.

devices.name: Micro On/Off
notes: HouseLinc lists the regional versions as the 2443-222, 2443-422 and 2443-522.

devices.name: DIN Rail Dimmer
notes: HouseLinc also lists its identity under 2252-222.

devices.name: LampLinc Dimmer
notes: Linking and unlinking modes time out after 4 minutes.
Setting the on-level to 0 turns on resume dim.

devices.name: ToggleLinc Dimmer
notes: HouseLinc lists subcategory 0x1F for firmware 0x3A and later.

devices.name: ToggleLinc On/Off
notes: HouseLinc lists subcategory 0x1A for firmware 0x3A and later.

devices.name: SwitchLinc 2-Wire Dimmer
notes: Needs no neutral wire.
Repeats RF but not powerline.

devices.name: In-LineLinc Dimmer
notes: Linked by holding SET for 10 seconds.

devices.name: In-LineLinc Dimmer (Dual-Band)
notes: Returns its load and LEDs to their states before a power outage.

devices.name: In-LineLinc 0-10V Dimmer
notes: HouseLinc names it INSTEON Ballast Dimmer.
Drives a 0-10 V output and two relayed loads; on cmd1 0x11 or 0x13, cmd2 0x01 selects load 1, 0x02 load 2 and 0x03 both.
Turns on at 100% at power-up.

devices.name: In-LineLinc Relay
notes: Linked by holding SET for 10 seconds.

devices.name: SwitchLinc Relay Countdown Timer
notes: When its timer runs out it sends off to its group's members, unless its group control option is turned off.

devices.name: SwitchLinc Dimmer 240V
notes: Returns its load and LEDs to their states before a power outage.

devices.name: KeypadLinc Countdown Timer, 8 Buttons
notes: Buttons A to H start 2, 5, 10, 15 and 30 minute and 1 and 2 hour timers, and turn the load off.
Turns its load off for a second a minute before a timer ends, unless that's turned off.
Has one ALL-Link group.

devices.name: KeypadLinc Dimmer, 6 Buttons
notes: Each button other than the load's can be set to toggle, send only off, or send only on.

devices.name: KeypadLinc Dimmer, 8 Buttons
notes: Each button other than the load's can be set to toggle, send only off, or send only on.

devices.name: KeypadLinc On/Off
notes: HouseLinc also lists its identity under 2487S-50.

devices.name: On/Off Outdoor Module
notes: Has no X10.

devices.name: On/Off Outlet
notes: Both outlets are switched, each by its own group.

devices.name: LED Bulb A19
notes: Has no buttons or LED.
Can be set to turn on when power returns; that's off by default.

devices.name: LED Bulb PAR38
notes: Has no buttons or LED.

devices.name: Thermostat for Heat Pump
notes: The 2441TH's hardware with heat pump firmware.
HouseLinc labels subcategories 0x13 to 0x15 as 2732-232, 2732-432 and 2732-532.
Subcategories 0x17 and 0x18 are the Thermostat 2.0 firmware, the regional versions of the 2441TH's 0x16.
HouseLinc also lists subcategories 0x0F and 0x11 for the 2732-422 and 2732-432, and 0x10 and 0x12 for the 2732-522 and 2732-532.

devices.name: Motorized Shades
notes: On opens and off closes; fast on and fast off open and close fully; brighten and dim start opening and closing, and stopping ends the movement.
Doesn't repeat INSTEON messages.

devices.name: I/O Linc
notes: Each relay's momentary time can be set from 0.2 seconds to 100 minutes.

devices.name: Motion Sensor
notes: HouseLinc also lists its US identity under the 2420M.

devices.name: Open/Close Sensor
notes: HouseLinc lists subcategory 0x09 as the Door Sensor 2843-232.
sources: Insteon command workbook, HeartBeat Status sheet

devices.name: Motion Sensor II
notes: Groups other than 1 are off by default.
Its heartbeat's cmd1, 0x11 to 0x14, gives the battery level from fully charged to almost empty.
Optional groups report temperature and light levels.
sources: 2844-x22 Motion Sensor II and III PRDs

devices.name: Hidden Door Sensor
notes: Sends closed to group 2 only when set to.
Sends a heartbeat at most every 24 hours; its PRD leaves the group undecided.

devices.name: Leak Sensor
notes: Its heartbeat sends on when dry and off when wet.
Once wet, it ignores further changes until its SET button is pressed.
sources: Insteon command workbook, HeartBeat Status sheet

devices.name: ICON LampLinc
notes: HouseLinc also lists its identity under 2856D2B.

devices.name: Deadbolt
notes: It's asleep most of the time, so it may take a few seconds to answer a command.

devices.name: Smoke Bridge
notes: HouseLinc names it Smoke Detector.
It sends INSTEON messages over powerline only; its radio only listens for the smoke alarms it's paired with.
Tapping its SET button sends each group's command as a test, ending with the all-clear.
It sends a heartbeat to group 0x0A, which software can turn off; its interval isn't documented.

devices.name: Range Extender
notes: Repeats INSTEON messages between powerline and RF, and bridges the two powerline phases.
Answers status requests and beeps; it has no load to control.
